modern_benchmark_candidates.name: COCO bbob-constrained
strengths: Modern, scalable and license-clear single-objective constrained suite.
Forty-five of 54 functions per dimension have m>=3 and can exercise the graph mechanism; nine m=1 functions are natural fallback controls.
The API exposes individual constraint values and an official result archive with cross-family comparators.
Using the package as a pinned dependency avoids copying the benchmark implementation into the project.
required_protocol_resolutions: Bind a package artifact hash and environment before any evaluator call.
Define a paired oracle call that obtains one objective value and one full constraint vector for the same x; require objective-call count == constraint-call count == project formal FFE.
Prevent hidden feasibility checks, target-hit probes or recommendations from consuming unledgered calls.
Freeze whether the provided feasible initial solution is inserted and how remaining population members are generated identically across stochastic algorithms.
Freeze dimensions, instances, algorithm seeds, budget, restart policy and problem-level inferential unit before execution.
Keep CEC2006 and COCO analyses in separately declared families; do not retroactively merge them into the existing preregistration.

modern_benchmark_candidates.name: CEC2020 real-world 57-problem suite through ENOPPY 0.1.1
modern_benchmark_candidates.existing_project_identity_evidence: RC15, RC16 and RC19 have an independent ENOPPY cross-check in the predecessor project; RC24 is not usable through ENOPPY 0.1.1.
modern_benchmark_candidates.reason: The GPL implementation resolves redistribution for ENOPPY itself, but suite-wide formula identity, discrete-variable policy, constraint sign/order and all 57 problem interfaces are not validated. The official repository remains unlicensed for redistribution.

modern_benchmark_candidates.name: CEC2017 constrained real-parameter suite
modern_benchmark_candidates.reason: Official benchmark files are available, but repository availability is not redistribution permission. It cannot close the requested license gate without permission or a licensed independent implementation.

external_baseline_candidates.paper: LSHADE44 with an Improved Epsilon Constraint-Handling Method for Solving Constrained Single-Objective Optimization Problems
paper_contract_observed: 28 CEC2017 problems, D in {10,30,50,100}, 25 independent runs and MaxFEs=20000D
IEpsilon parameters cp=2, theta=20%, Tc=0.8MaxFEs, alpha=0.5 and tau=0.1
The paper reports comparisons with CAL-SHADE, LSHADE44+IDE, LSHADE44 and UDE
external_baseline_candidates.implementation_rule: Do not copy CEC archives or unlicensed third-party source. Prepare an independently authored specification from the primary paper and its cited LSHADE44 definition, then expected-red conformance tests and an identity limitation statement.

external_baseline_candidates.identity: CMA-ES with adaptive augmented-Lagrangian constraint handling via ConstrainedFitnessAL
external_baseline_candidates.accounting_note: Use which='best' to avoid the documented additional objective/constraint update evaluation, wrap every x in the common paired evaluator ledger, and hard-stop at the frozen budget.
external_baseline_candidates.equality_note: For suites with equalities, freeze the two-inequality epsilon transformation and count it as one paired evaluator call, not as extra FFE.

external_baseline_candidates.local_identity: Installed in the current Python environment; no solver was called.
external_baseline_candidates.identity: Pure-Python PRIMA COBYLA exposed by scipy.optimize.minimize
external_baseline_candidates.accounting_note: The documented maxiter is the maximum number of function evaluations. A common memoizing paired evaluator must prevent separate objective and constraint callbacks at the same x from double-counting project FFE.

external_baseline_candidates.license: MPL-2.0 for PyGMO package metadata; GPL-3.0-or-later OR LGPL-3.0-or-later for Pagmo
external_baseline_candidates.reason: The official documentation states that an internal cache makes the final fitness-evaluation count somewhat unpredictable and that behavior depends strongly on the inner algorithm. This conflicts with the project's exact equal-FFE contract unless a separately validated cutoff adapter changes the execution semantics.

matrix_recommendation.rationale: B1 closes modern-suite licensing and exposes the individual residual vector required by CVGR. A1 is the nearest strong constrained-DE peer but must be clean-room and conformance-gated; A2 supplies a strong stochastic cross-family comparator with permissive licensing; A3 is a deterministic local sanity control rather than a headline peer.
matrix_recommendation.engineering_transfer: Keep CEC2020-M4 as an independently authorized benchmark-level supplement only. It is neither a replacement for the modern suite nor physical validation.
matrix_recommendation.inference_boundary: No superiority, broad generalization or paper-readiness conclusion is permitted from this static shortlist.

blocking_findings.finding: The modern benchmark and external comparator set are not part of the currently frozen plan or preregistration.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Author selects an option and authorizes versioned amendment preparation; a later candidate must be frozen before implementation or execution.

blocking_findings.finding: COCO counts objective and constraint evaluations separately while the project defines one combined objective-plus-full-constraint-vector evaluation as one formal FFE.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Freeze paired-call semantics and prove objective_calls == constraint_calls == formal_ffe in additive red/green adapter tests.

blocking_findings.finding: COCO provides a feasible initial solution, whereas CVGR activation requires informative infeasible histories and the current plan assumes shared population initialization.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Freeze a common initialization policy and report activation/fallback rates; do not tune initialization after observing performance.

blocking_findings.finding: LSHADE44-IEpsilon is scientifically relevant, but no license-closed source implementation has been selected and conformance to the paper is untested.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Prepare a clean-room versioned specification and expected-red identity tests before production implementation.

blocking_findings.finding: External algorithms have different native population, restart, equality and initialization semantics.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Preserve native mechanisms while freezing the same problem implementation, paired evaluation budget, seed/instance set, termination boundary and result comparator; report deviations explicitly.

blocking_findings.finding: The official CEC2020 repository exposes software but no repository license was observed. ENOPPY is GPLv3 but suite-wide identity is unverified.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Do not vendor official source; use only separately licensed dependencies or independent implementations with identity audits. Keep CEC2020-M4 supplemental.

next_safe_gate: Author selection of benchmark/baseline route and authorization to prepare a versioned plan amendment plus additive specifications and expected-red adapter tests only. This audit itself does not authorize any package installation, production code, evaluator call, optimizer run or formal FFE.
